pool.text: [KAUST Academy] A research institute has \( 8 \) fellows. A collection of **distinct** committees \( C_1, \dots, C_m \subseteq \{1, \dots, 8\} \) (possibly including the empty committee) is formed such that every committee \( |C_i| \) is **even**, and every pairwise intersection \( |C_i \cap C_j| \) is **even**. What is the maximum possible number \( m \) of committees?
pool.educational_aim: Master KAUST Campus Finals & Academy Advanced Synthesis via authentic Olympiad, NSMO of KSA, and KAUST KMC problem-solving (hard tier).

If \( \sum c_i \mathbf{v}_i = \mathbf{0} \), taking the dot product with \( \mathbf{v}_k \) gives \( c_k = 0 \) for every \( k \).
